brief.scope: Independently assess supplied GPT-6 consolidation PLAN against updated owner brief and inventory. Owner requires one worker execution path, configurable adapters/policy, permanent dev/prod independence and no Symfony app dependency. Identify smallest complete critical path before conduct; distinguish needed convergence from optional dormant/manual features. The 28-slice roadmap is not admitted as a prerequisite. Explicit refusal of obsolete unsupported paths is allowed when declared and tested; do not require new fileset or legacy capabilities without a demonstrated current obligation. Reconcile all entrypoints/recipes, output-permission defect, custody/supervision and existing conformance. Shared lane policy is separately owned; doctrine correction already runs there, no duplicate ownership. Return <=1200-word verdict and prioritized dependency/acceptance changes, command/ref evidence and limits. Read-only; no source/tests/settings/DB/host/network changes or vendor launches. No implementation approval.

artifacts.VERDICT:
VERDICT: changes. Independent read-only assessment of the PLAN carried in .dev/records/dispatches/20260906T013433Z-plan-codex-1d09bc.json:148, measured at HEAD 0c1ff052796e17890a528d04acd35eac5f778513, base c06ed9442ba51c9e96aa8de9f9bde93d0843a6cc. No implementation is approved and nothing was dispatched.

ADMITTED AS CORRECT. The plan applies every owner correction: dev machinery stays under ops/ permanently, no Symfony application dependency, no prod twin or retirement trajectory, no new executor, registry or lifecycle store, Loopstrap as patterns only, models configurable and never tabled in code. launch.py is the right authoritative service. Its two central diagnoses re-measure true here. (a) jobs.json:57,60 requires {out}/PLAN.md, while launch.py:952 and :1213 grant a writable out only when job == 'check-tests' and :1189 hard-codes that job to codex workspace-write; adjudicate (jobs.json:90-95) also declares an out/ file and never gets one, so two jobs are broken by one name-branch. (b) The launcher validates against ENVELOPE.ENVELOPE_SCHEMA alone (launch.py:64,743) while task's authority additionally enforces counts == tally, the exact field tuple and handle limits (envelope.py:253-310), so launcher and task do not accept the same envelope. Its single P2 against the startup document still holds at this head: grep -n consolidat ops/conductor/conductor-start-plan.md returns nothing. Its baseline is current: git diff --name-only e59a52bc HEAD -- ops/devlane ops/bin ops/conductor/tools ops/process docs .claude/skills/cross-review returns no paths, so no re-audit is owed and the supplied inventory stands.

WHERE IT FAILS THE BRIEF. The plan answers 'what would a complete consolidation contain', not 'what is the smallest complete path before conduct'. In its ordering the owner's one measured defect (S04) and every caller-convergence slice (S16-S18) sit behind a counterparty that does not exist in this tree, and behind a fileset capability with no demonstrated obligation (S13 to S14 to S15 to S16) whose absence launch.py already handles with the declared refusal the owner permits (launch.py:1095; CONTRACT.md:243). Thirteen of the 28 buckets grant launch.py and the plan serializes repeated paths, so the roadmap is a near-serial chain of about thirteen four-producer cycles over one 2,146-line file. Findings 1-6 carry the detail.

SMALLEST COMPLETE CRITICAL PATH, recommended for admission in place of S00-S27 as the prerequisite:

C1 execution boundary contract (S00 narrowed): boundary, request fields, one envelope authority, adapter seam, output-grant derivation, refusal table, and the disposition of every non-converged path. Files: ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md, ops/devlane/task/CONTRACT.md. No dependency.

C2 output grants (S04 with the external dependency cut): derive writable roots from each job's declared outputs in jobs.json instead of the job-name branch; refuse where the harness cannot hold source read-only while writing out/. Depends on C1 only. This is the one defect with a failed run behind it and belongs first, not tenth.

C3 one acceptance rule (S03 plus only the semantic half of S02): route launcher acceptance through task's validator, keep the optional commit key and the declared transport, drop the duplicate key tuple at launch.py:642. Depends on C1.

C4 supervision parity (S11): replace the inline token predicate with the telemetry breaker, aggregate accounting and the Grok cumulative source. Independent of C2 and C3; runs in parallel.

C5-C7 adapter extraction, codex then claude then grok (S06-S08), with declared and observed capability descriptors (S09). This is what conduct step 3 — 'separate Claude/Codex/Grok adapters, exact argument forwarding' — actually needs.

C8 selection convergence (S16, S17, S18 with the S15/S14 dependency removed): one normalized request from dispatch.sh, go.sh and ladder. go.sh's claude defaults for plan, tests and implement (go.sh:38,39,41) and ladder's fixed stage-to-harness table (ladder.py:26-35) become configured selection checked in one place against the launcher's admission rule (launch.py:1088).

C9 declared refusals for the non-converged paths, replacing S15 and S19-S23: task/run.py's vendor path, the shell levers and the cross-review recipe each get an explicit tested refusal or an owner-admitted retirement, with historical records preserved.

Conduct may start when C1-C9 are green and the lane-policy handoff exists. The policy join (S10) stays with the lane-boundary track and is consumed, not built.

DEFERRED, admitted only on a demonstrated obligation — a measured caller, a failed run, or an owner ruling: S13/S14 staging and fileset; S15 task frontend; S19-S23 lever and recipe migration; S24 probes; S25/S26 wire gate and adoption (the conformance gate is scoped to ops/conductor/tools/*.py at test_instrument_conventions.py:35,120, so registering launch.py is a real but separable obligation); S27 closure; and S01 doctrine, which belongs to the track already correcting it.

ACCEPTANCE CHANGES, prioritized. (1) C2's witnesses must be per-harness, not the codex check-tests suite alone: claude read roles run acceptEdits with --add-dir out and no Write/Edit denial, so 'source isolation retained' is unproven for claude and grok. (2) Every deferred path needs its refusal test in C9 — exit class and refusal line asserted — before it is called converged. (3) C3 needs a positive control for the authorized inline-artifact mode and a negative for counts/status inconsistency, since the launcher accepts today what task refuses. (4) Machine lines must be emitted one dependency-ready bucket at a time, or the driver change must be in scope. (5) Each slice names the suites it must not move; ops/bin/suites.sh:21 discovers every test_*.py, so the regression floor is mechanical and the plan's 'relevant files include' list is inventory, not the floor.
